records.title: Task-focused product shell
records.summary: Keep persistent navigation quiet and reserve the strongest hierarchy for the user's current task and next action.
evidence: Can a returning user reach the primary task without scanning promotional content?
Does navigation remain understandable at narrow widths?

records.title: Trust-first checkout
records.summary: Make cost, commitment, data use, validation, recovery, and the final action explicit before decorative persuasion.
evidence: Are total cost and renewal terms visible before submission?
Can users recover from validation errors without losing input?

records.title: Editorial story landing
records.summary: Use authored pacing, expressive type hierarchy, and selective media to turn a narrative into sections without making every block a card.
evidence: Does each section advance one narrative beat?
Is the reading order intact without animation?

records.title: Restrained accent system
records.summary: Assign a limited accent palette to semantic actions and status so emphasis remains predictable instead of decorative.
avoidWhen: approved expressive brand palette with documented roles
evidence: Can each accent be named by purpose?
Do contrast and non-color cues still communicate state?

records.title: Readable product typography
records.summary: Use a compact role-based type scale with stable line length and line height for repeated interface reading.
evidence: Are labels, values, help, and errors distinguishable without relying on color?
Does text reflow without clipping at zoom?

records.title: Container and grid rhythm
records.summary: Define a small set of content widths, gutters, and layout gaps so sections align without forcing every surface into identical cards.
avoidWhen: intentional full-bleed composition with documented anchors
evidence: Do major edges share explainable anchors?
Does the grid recompose instead of merely shrinking?

records.title: Progressive disclosure for advanced controls
records.summary: Keep common choices visible and reveal advanced configuration without hiding required context or current state.
avoidWhen: all fields are required to complete the task
hidden options would change cost or commitment
evidence: Can users discover the advanced path?
Does collapsed state summarize active non-default values?

records.title: Visible keyboard focus
records.summary: Provide a distinguishable focus indicator that remains visible when controls overlap, scroll, or use custom styling.
avoidWhen: never; adapt the treatment rather than removing focus
evidence: Can every interactive element be reached and identified by keyboard?
Is focus obscured by sticky or modal content?

records.title: Reflow without loss
records.summary: Recompose reading and action order at narrow widths or zoom so required content and controls remain available without two-dimensional scrolling.
avoidWhen: content intrinsically requires two-dimensional layout, such as a map or large data table
evidence: Does content remain operable at narrow CSS widths?
Are exceptions isolated rather than applied to the whole page?

records.title: Comparison-first dashboard
records.summary: Organize metrics around the comparisons and decisions users make, with context and units adjacent to each value.
evidence: What comparison should each chart enable?
Are units, periods, filters, and freshness visible?

records.title: Scannable data table
records.summary: Align values by meaning, keep row identity stable, and make sorting, filtering, density, and overflow explicit.
avoidWhen: visual trend is more important than exact values
evidence: Can users identify the row after horizontal or vertical movement?
Do numeric alignment and units support comparison?

records.title: Motion as feedback with a reduced path
records.summary: Use motion to explain state change or continuity, keep it interruptible, and provide a reduced-motion treatment.
evidence: What information would be lost without the animation?
Does reduced motion preserve the state change?

records.title: Actionable empty state
records.summary: Explain why content is absent, whether that is expected, and the safest next action without using filler illustration as the message.
avoidWhen: loading or error state is still unresolved
evidence: Can the user distinguish empty, loading, error, and access-denied states?
Is the proposed action available to this user?

records.title: Mobile touch priority
records.summary: Reorder the interface around the highest-frequency mobile action and keep controls targetable without shrinking desktop density into a narrow column.
avoidWhen: mobile is a read-only companion with different documented tasks
evidence: Is the primary action reachable and stable when the keyboard opens?
Are target size and spacing verified?

records.title: Dark theme semantic pairs
records.summary: Define dark-theme values by semantic role and interaction state rather than mechanically inverting the light palette.
avoidWhen: brand approval covers only one theme
evidence: Are elevation and disabled states still distinguishable?
Are contrast checks run on actual composed surfaces?

records.title: Calm enterprise form
records.summary: Use clear grouping, restrained surfaces, persistent context, and explicit validation for long or consequential forms.
evidence: Can users see scope and progress?
Are dependencies and errors located next to the affected field?

records.title: CJK interface typography verification
records.summary: Verify glyph coverage, Chinese line-breaking and punctuation behavior, mixed-script hierarchy, locale-aware numbers and dates, and text expansion in the actual target fonts and layouts.
signals: font coverage is unknown or unverified
avoidWhen: the interface contains no CJK content and has no target CJK locale
evidence: Do the selected fonts cover required glyphs and weights without fallback drift?
Do line breaks, punctuation, numerals, dates, and mixed-script alignment remain correct in representative content?
